lines.text: Dimension is the measurement of length in one direction.
A Point has no or zero dimensions. It has only its position. It has no length,
width, or height. We can see a combination of points as lines, but on its
own, a point has no dimension.
A Line segment has one-dimension and that is its length. It is made
up by a combination of points.
A flat shape or 2-D shape has two dimensions i.e. length and width. Squares, rectangles,
triangles, etc.are examples of 2-D shapes.
A solid shape or 3-D shape has three dimensions. The three dimensions of a solid are its
length, width, and height. Let's learn about 3-D objects.
Consider these objects.
All these shapes are 3-D objects we use in our daily life. We call
them 3-D shapes because they all have length, width and height.
